# Simulate prior distribution

Simulate prior distribution

## Usage

``` r
compute_map(eta, mean = 0, sd = 1)
```

## Arguments

- eta:

  vector

- mean:

  numeric

- sd:

  numeric

## Examples

``` r
eta<-seq(-6,6,by=0.1)
compute_map(eta=eta,mean=0,sd=1)
```
